text: {"lessons":["The account’s early losses and later rebound show that monthly stock values can fluctuate; I should not treat one month’s move as a reliable signal.","Selling Stocks D and E after large declines locked in those losses, so I should avoid selling solely because a holding has fallen and instead reassess it against my plan.","As a retired investor who needs stability, I should keep trading deliberate and infrequent, and make sure my overall exposure suits my need to preserve savings."]}
